title: IBM Cyber Fraud 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 could allow a local attacker to bypass security restrictions due… (CVE-2026-97683)
description: IBM Cyber Fraud versions 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 contain a vulnerability that could allow a local attacker to bypass security restrictions due to a missing or misconfigured security context. The vulnerability has a low severity score and does not impact confidentiality or availability but may cause limited integrity issues.
